About the club

Shared ambition.

Bringing people together across the audiovisual industry, from established voices to emerging leaders.

Founded in 2026
Birmingham, United Kingdom

Our beginnings

A stronger voice.
A wider conversation.

Charlie Ji founded The Avant-garde Club alongside its founding members and a wider group of young, passionate AV professionals working across the UK and Europe.

Their aim was to bring the community together and give young professionals a stronger voice in the future of the industry.

Our community

Across roles.
Across the industry.

Members come from both the professional and consumer sides of audiovisual.

B2B

AV for organisations

Professional displays, workplace collaboration and integrated audiovisual systems.

D2C

AV for everyday life

Consumer audiovisual products and the experiences people use in their own lives.

Our values

What brings
us together.

Community
Make room for different perspectives across the AV industry.
Generosity
Share experience and help others move forward.
Curiosity
Ask questions and explore ambitious ideas with an open mind.
Trust
Respect one another and approach sensitive discussions with discretion.
